name: [BITRIX] TENDER — Ошибка доставки Bitrix
description: Fail-closed error workflow for Bitrix delivery executions. It marks only an execution-owned sending row as unknown and never schedules a retry.

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.tender_analysis_deliveries
SET
    status = 'unknown',
    next_attempt_at = NULL,
    last_error_code = 'BITRIX_UNHANDLED_WORKFLOW_FAILURE',
    last_error_message = 'Unhandled delivery workflow failure; automatic retry is disabled',
    updated_at = now()
WHERE n8n_execution_id = $1
  AND status = 'sending'
RETURNING
    id AS delivery_id,
    analysis_run_id,
    status AS delivery_status,
    attempt_count;
